parameters.query: with prev as (select value, updated_at from settings where key = 'last_scrape_msg'), up as (insert into settings (key, value, updated_at) values ('last_scrape_msg', $1, now()) on conflict (key) do update set value = excluded.value, updated_at = now()) select coalesce((select value = $1 and updated_at > now() - interval '2 minutes' from prev), false) as dup, (select value from settings where key = 'last_no_captions_url') as last_no_captions
